content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Boise

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's official requirements to confirm you meet the education and experience thresholds before enrolling in bootcamp training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP bootcamp. Our instructor-led course delivers the full 35 contact hours required by PMI, combining lecture, interactive exercises, and real-world case studies—all conducted online to fit your Boise schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp, submit your official PMP application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about documentation and application requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE and sit for the PMP examination online or at a testing center near you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) over each three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer continuing-education options to help you stay current and renew on schedule.
